name: state-english-vocabulary
description: Easy English in Action includes Vocabulary, Grammar, Phrasal Verbs, Idioms and Reading. Connect Vocabulary to review progress and save words from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Easy English in Action brings together five English-learning apps: Vocabulary, Grammar, Phrasal Verbs, Idioms and Reading. Practise words and expressions, study grammar, and read and listen to levelled stories in our web and mobile apps.

In ChatGPT, connect your English Vocabulary in Action account to review your vocabulary learning progress. See the words you are learning or have learned, find entries in the app's English catalogue, and add selected words to your Added to learn list.

You choose which words to add. When a word has several matching meanings, ChatGPT can help you select the intended catalogue entry before saving it. New additions appear in the Vocabulary app after it connects and syncs with the same account. Words already queued, in learning, or learned are reported separately.

An email/password Vocabulary account is required. If you started anonymously, link an email account inside the app first. The ChatGPT connection currently supports existing Vocabulary catalogue entries; Grammar, Phrasal Verbs, Idioms and Reading are available in our web and mobile apps. Progress reflects the latest data synced by your Vocabulary app.
defaultPrompt: Show five words I am currently learning.
Find resilient and reliable in the catalogue and help me add them to learn.
